why: No major reviewer or authority appears at all: no RTINGS, Wirecutter, Tom's Guide, Plex support page or maker spec page. Every result is an affiliate roundup or a niche spec/price tracker; five answer the budget-plus-Quick-Sync question with specs and prices but none with testing anyone can check, and they contradict each other on the DS225+ (nasdecoded says it transcodes, selfhostlife says it lost it). One result is unreadable, one is Synology-only, one gets Quick Sync wrong. A focused page listing the Intel-iGPU NAS boxes actually under $500 today, with tested 4K-to-1080p and HDR tone-map stream counts, the Plex Pass caveat, the DS225+ situation settled, and current prices/codes would stand out, exactly as in the solar-kit win.
